_source.title: 焊盘热焊优化参数
_source.remarks.text.0: 当连接方式（{@link IPCB_PrimitivePadHeatWelding.connectionMethod | connectionMethod}）为直连（{@link EPCB_PrimitivePadHeatWeldingConnectionMethod.DIRECT_CONNECTED | DIRECT_CONNECTED}）、无连接（{@link EPCB_PrimitivePadHeatWeldingConnectionMethod.NON_CONNECTED | NON_CONNECTED}）时，发散间距、发散线宽、发散角度的设置将被忽略
